title: Minimum species sample value
desc: Only consider species whose sample value >= this amount

title: Minimum body value
desc: Only consider bodies whose combined SIGNIFICANT sample values >= this amount

title: Maximum body distance from star
desc: Ignore biologicals on bodies > this distance from the star

title: Radius around which plotter will look for systems
desc: Set 25-50 for straight routes or 150-200 for loop routes

title: Maximum number of results in route
Make a loop route
desc: If ON, route will loop back to starting system

title: Announce bio scan results
desc: If ON, will comment when you Composition scan or Bio scan a sample.

title: Announce when move too close / far enough away from prior sampled colonies
desc: If ON, will comment when you move far enough away from a previous sample, or when you move back too close to a previous sample

title: Scan all systems on jump for significant biologicals
desc: If ON, will always scan when you jump into a system. If OFF, will only scan systems in your Exo Mastery Route bookmark group.

title: Announce systems with no significant biological samples
desc: Will tell you when you jump into a system with no significant biological samples to scan

title: Auto display the biologicals details
desc: Automatically display the 'Biologicals In System' panel when announcing significant biological samples

title: Auto plot to next Exo Mastery system in route
desc: Will plot to your next Exo Master Route system once you finish scanning all lucrative bodies in current Exo Route system

title: Guide to closest known sample on OC
desc: When you enter OC on a body with known biologicals, will guide you to the closest known sample from your current location

title: Remind you on sample scan completion if EDMC is not running
desc: If ON, will remind you to run EDMC when you scan a new sample, so the location can be recorded on backend databases

title: First foot fall detection
desc: If on, will attempt to detect first foot fall via image captures
